note: Renames gRPC lanes to worker streams across the consumer, including the ack timeout setting and env var to INGESTION_WORKER_STREAM_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS.
Adds a local sectionPanel helper taking key, dataAttr, title, count, content and rewrites all three collapse panels to use it.
Drops detector_evaluation_ids from the context activity output; the agent activity now loads them by team_id via _load_detector_evaluation_ids.
Tracks the in-flight flush so stop() waits for it before closing the pool; does not split the service into a separate deployable.
Introduces an exported PROSE_LANGUAGE constant in steps.ts and uses it in the Go tab, other docs, and the onboarding renderer.
Replaces the inline finish_reason check in reconstructOutputChoice with a call to the shared usableStopReason helper.
Derives work ownership from claim artefacts and drops the assignment claim FK; the SignalReportPullRequest model stays in place.
Moves the claim saved query and claims_enabled onto AccountRelationshipDefinition, removing them from the team config, with a per-definition unique view.
Deletes set_first_release_condition_rollout and its tests; the survey sampling task now calls set_release_condition_rollout with index 0.
Removes channel FK from SignalReport and adds a channel_assignment status artefact type with a channel FK on the artefact model.
Backend records the config route and serializes reason_states_rollout; banner passes it to rolloutSentence instead of reading last_called_at.
Adds a hasStaticCohort selector to the warning logic and the component uses it instead of substring-matching the warning text.
ready now requires is_materialization_fresh(materialized_at, data_freshness_seconds), a shared freshness predicate also used by execution.
Destination icon now comes from the targetTypeOptions lookup by target type instead of per-type conditional icon rendering.
Adds a ScannerBudget with a single blocked property (would_exceed of one observation cost) meant for both gates and the API.
Extracts the copy popover into a useCellCopyContextMenu hook module, but extractCellText stays exported from LemonTable.tsx.
Removes the component's URL/persisted date sync effect; shared and dashboard Kea logics now own dashboard date state, with logic tests.
Deletes the piExtensionEditorText.ts one-line wrapper file.
Registers the lifecycle sweeper with the lifecycle manager, holds a process scope guard in the task, and listens for shutdown.
Keeps the separate file but folds the live widget seed payload type into it and deletes types.ts, so the file holds more than one export.
